Event: Col(palette number)

Related Events: set, col, version
Related Actions: changecol, letpal
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

col(palette number)

First defined in: FKiSS1
The col events are called when the viewer changes to the palette specified.
The number of palettes is limited to the KCF with the greatest number of palettes, therefore palette number is limited to that range.
This event can be triggered by one of the following:
  • The user switches palettes manually through the viewer interface
  • Use of the changecol action
  • A change to the palette caused by changing the current set
There can only be one col event for each palette.

Example:

;@ col(2) If palette 2 is changed to, notify user
;@ notify("Now in black and white.")
